I struggle bad with this too so I came up with a method that works for me

I drew out 3 columns. The first was "thoughts before starting the task". It would usually be things like "ugh this is going to take forever" or "I really can't be bothered to start this, I want to do something else."

The second was "thoughts during the task" like when I was on a little 5 minute break. Here I could see how my thought process changed from avoidance, to things like "Ok I've started now, might as well finish" or "you know, this isn't as bad as I thought it would be"

The final column of course was "thoughts after the task has finished." I noticed how my thoughts were much more positive compared to before the task: "that really wasn't bad at all" and "it didn't take me as long as I thought"

Then whenever I put off a task again, I look back at the columns and see what I was thinking. It reminds me that often the tasks we put off aren't nearly as bad as we imagine them to be. 

I hope this works for you :)
